title: Bounded flat criterion for coefficient-model Tor tests
statement: For a small site (C,J) in universe w, a commutative ring sheaf R with modules in the same universe, K in its standard derived localization, and integers a <= b, the coefficient-model Tor test in [a,b] holds if and only if there is a complex P with flat terms, zero below a and above b, and Q(P) isomorphic to K. The predicate is HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude and the flatness predicate is SheafOfModules.IsFlat.

source.place: Tags 08G0 and 08G1; native source FlatModel criterion, transported to the coefficient-model predicate.

proof.text: Use functorial flat covers to supply categorical flat resolutions; symmetry identifies one-sided sheaf flatness with categorical flatness.
Identify acyclic-test K-flatness with native quasi-isomorphism-preserving K-flatness using the homotopy-category acyclic criterion and symmetry.

On each K-flat representative the native derived tensor is the same total tensor in the coefficient-model test. Homology localization identifies their vanishing conditions. Apply the source theorem DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn_iff_exists_iso_Q_obj_flat; its proof resolves above and truncates below, proving flatness of the first opcycle by the tensor exactness criterion.

theorem coefficientModelTorAmplitude_iff_flatModel (K : ConstantCompletion.D R)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude R K a b ↔
      ∃ (P : ConstantCompletion.Cx R) (_ : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (_ : P.IsStrictlyLE b),
        (∀ i, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (R := R) (P.X i)) ∧
          Nonempty ((ConstantCompletion.Q R).obj P ≅ K)
